findings: The fire triangle has fuel, oxygen and heat in distinct readable sectors. Cooling a wood fire and limiting oxygen in the protected bell-jar model show two interruption principles.

The former unsupported fire-blanket panel is replaced by a clearly labelled class-F cooking-fat extinguisher used by a firefighter, alongside the prominent warning never to put water on a fat fire. This aligns with DGUV Information 205-001 section 8.4.9 for suitable class-F equipment in public/commercial settings; the image does not portray a learner operating it.

The three panel headings and central warning remain legible in the actual 360-pixel preview; the 16:9-ish friendly comic illustration fits the existing landscape. The small triangle labels at 360 are secondary to the larger headings and the visible symbols.
